accounts.label: likely_genuine
accounts.rationale: Despite a high pass-through ratio and only three distinct payers, this nearly two-year-old business account has a very low tainted share, no device or phone links to known mules, and the trace branch terminated as absorbed_genuine. The balance of evidence favors a genuine business whose account was incidentally used to receive tainted funds.

verdicts.reason: The account received the full disputed Rs 1,021,881.09 and still retains Rs 759,664.54 of tainted funds (tainted share ~10.3%) within a large Rs 7,392,818.55 balance. The lien freezes only the victim's traceable money; the account's own funds remain untouched, and the genuine-business indicators (692-day age, no mule device links, zero related cases) do not bar recovery of stolen funds.
